note: People inside rooms (roadmap item 41; core/game/game_people.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). Each service interior (GameSpaces layouts: forge, temple, store, tavern, board, black_market) has one person standing at a fixed cell `at` of its entrance room (a cell of the interior's own floor, x east and z south from the door). The person is a solid cell (GameInterior marks it `person`) and the heir talks to them by standing on a floor cell beside it and using it: a line of greeting, and in the town where the family is the service opens (`open`: shop, workshop, tavern or board; `tab` the shop's tab). Away from that town the person only talks. Nothing here is random or saved, and the autopilot never walks in.

people.name: Brann the smith
people.greet: Brann looks up from the anvil. "Metal or mending?"

people.name: Sister Ione
people.greet: Sister Ione folds her hands. "The temple is open to the weary."

people.name: Odo the storekeeper
people.greet: Odo wipes the counter. "Anything caught your eye?"

people.name: Marta the host
people.greet: Marta sets down a mug. "Sit, and tell me your news."

people.name: Pell the clerk
people.greet: Pell taps the notices. "Work for willing hands."

people.name: A hooded fence
people.greet: The fence says nothing, then, low: "Quiet prices. Quiet deals."

text.only_talk: {name} has nothing for you here: the family is not in this town.
text.nobody: There is nobody here to talk to.
